# FaceMeX

> FaceMeX is an AI-powered learning and career-preparation platform for students, graduates, and job seekers.

FaceMeX combines AI-supported learning conversations and practical activities with job discovery, CV and document preparation, and interview practice. Some workspace features require an account and sign-in.

AI responses may be incomplete or incorrect. Verify important facts with trusted sources. Job listings and application details can change; confirm them with the employer or original source.
